Landing.heroTitle: Educating the Next Generation of AI Practitioners
Landing.heroBody: Texas Institute of Artificial Intelligence partners with accredited U.S. institutions to deliver career-focused AI, Computer Science, and Information Systems education for international talent pathways.
Landing.aboutBody: TIAI is a Texas nonprofit focused on rigorous, employment-driven AI education through accredited institutional partnerships.
Landing.aboutPoint1Body: Every curriculum decision is aligned to practical outcomes in AI, CS, and Information Systems careers.
Landing.aboutPoint2Body: Academic authority remains with accredited partner colleges, including approvals, transcripts, and degrees.
Landing.aboutPoint3Body: The 2+2 pathway model supports structured, cost-efficient transfer outcomes for international students.
Landing.program1Body: From foundations to deployment: modern AI methods, model systems, and applied practice.
Landing.program2Body: Transfer-aligned CS curriculum including algorithms, systems, and engineering methods.
Landing.program3Body: Applied business-technology tracks: databases, BI, data workflows, and enterprise systems.
Landing.partnershipTitle: A Practical Model for College AI Programs
Landing.partnershipBody: TIAI acts as an instructional partner: institutions keep academic authority while TIAI provides delivery capacity and AI faculty network support.
Landing.partnershipStep1: Initial consultation to align strategic goals, enrollment targets, and implementation scope.
Landing.partnershipStep2: Faculty and curriculum alignment under institutional governance and credential standards.
Landing.partnershipStep3: Program launch with student support and transfer-outcome monitoring.
Landing.partnershipPoint1: Enrollment growth support with auditable operating model
Landing.partnershipPoint2: Access to AI/CS instructor network and curriculum support
Landing.partnershipPoint4: Simple service-fee model without complex revenue-sharing structure
Landing.partnershipGovernanceBody: Curriculum is submitted for institutional approval, instructors are credentialed by standards, and student records remain fully within college systems.
Landing.facultyBody: We welcome researchers, doctoral candidates, and industry practitioners to co-build high-quality AI education pathways.
Landing.facultyBenefit1Body: Contribute within an accredited U.S. college program environment with clear academic positioning.
Landing.facultyBenefit2Body: Founding network members receive early priority for paid teaching opportunities as programs scale.
Landing.facultyBenefit3Body: Applied curriculum work can be formally attributed as part of institutional teaching practice.
Landing.facultyBenefit4Body: Help shape global student pathways into the U.S. AI and technology workforce.
Landing.insight1Body: How curriculum design maps to job outcomes in U.S. tech markets.
Landing.insight2Body: Designing 2+2 pathways with strong articulation and transfer success.
Landing.insight3Body: Balancing institutional standards with real-world engineering practice.

Faculty.heroBody: TIAI is building a distributed network of AI educators, researchers, and industry practitioners to co-deliver high-quality education programs across partner institutions.
Faculty.role1Body: Teach courses within accredited partner college programs. All instructors are credentialed and appointed through institutional processes.
Faculty.role2Body: Contribute to course design, learning outcomes, and industry alignment without a full teaching commitment.
Faculty.role3Body: Collaborate on applied AI research and educational case studies. Formal attribution provided.
Faculty.benefit2: Priority access to paid teaching opportunities
Faculty.benefit4: Network of AI practitioners and educators
Faculty.ctaBody: Submit your background and interest area. Our academic team will follow up within 5 business days.
